title: Prompt Plot
description: The story one image communicates and the selected depiction decisions that serve it. Beat references preserve the basis of each choice, including context that guides visible performance. The author judges meaning, sufficient depiction and the scope of each choice. The approved plot is independent of the target interface.

approved.description: Present once the plot has been shown to the person who owns the brief and accepted. Generation-ready packaging requires it.

at.description: RFC3339 UTC, as adoption-receipt spells issued_at.

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the plot with its approved block removed, so the approval names the content it approved.

source.description: Where this plot came from, when it came from somewhere. A plot written from a brief has no source and the brief is its root. A plot written from an upstream artifact, such as an approved scene plot, names that artifact and the content hash it was approved under, so one image carries one approval chain rather than two that do not mention each other.

artifact_type.description: What the upstream artifact is, in its own vocabulary, such as scene-plot.

id.description: How the upstream artifact names itself, such as a scene id.

content_sha256.description: The hash the upstream artifact was approved under.

shot_id.description: Which shot of the upstream artifact this plot covers, where it plans several.

story.description: What happens in and around this image.

visibility.description: visible: this beat puts something in the frame. context: the fact belongs to the moment and may guide the choice or interpretation of visible performance while remaining context.

derived.description: Selected frame requirements and purposeful decisions, using the kinds the image needs. Each statement describes a useful realization or a condition to preserve. Open choices use free when their scope helps planning. Every visible beat has a linked frame statement.

kind.description: shows: necessary depicted content. placement: meaning-bearing spatial relationships. composition: selected framing that serves the intent. must_preserve: fixed requirements. free: open choices for planning, not a permission block for the prompt.

statement.description: Describe the selected depiction, required condition or open choice at its useful specificity. The author checks the interpretation against the established scene and character.

from.description: Story ids that ground this statement, including context used to choose a visible realization or preserve a condition. A link retains the beat's declared visibility and establishes source scope; the author evaluates the meaning of the chosen realization. Required for every kind except free.
